name: Takagamine Itsuka
source:
The god of severance and matchmaking.
He's now a high school teacher, but formerly he was a komataka (shrine guardian hawk with similar duties as a [URL=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komainu]komainu[/URL]) at the Takagamine Shrine.
As per Usagi's request, Itsuka watches over the protagonist at school.

[Translation of [URL=http://stars.ponipa.com/star_pe.html#pe_c]official profile[/URL].]
